$comment: Determinism is tracked as a KPI, not just a test. It degrades silently —
the game keeps running, replays and netcode just stop agreeing — and by
the time a player reports it the cause is many commits back.

kpis.name: contract_score
kpis.description: Headless checks passing: scenes, references, scripts, determinism, budget

kpis.name: sim_ms_per_tick

source.cmd: python3 -c "import json,subprocess;print(json.loads([l for l in subprocess.run(['python3','qa_check.py'],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout.splitlines() if l.strip().startswith('{')][-1])['per_tick_ms'])" 2>/dev/null || echo 999

kpis.description: Simulation cost per fixed tick, before any rendering. The budget rendering has to fit inside.

kpis.name: deterministic

source.cmd: python3 -c "import json,subprocess;d=json.loads([l for l in subprocess.run(['python3','qa_check.py'],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout.splitlines() if l.strip().startswith('{')][-1]);print(1 if all(c['ok'] for c in d['checks'] if c['name']=='deterministic') else 0)" 2>/dev/null || echo 0

kpis.description: Does the same seed still produce the same game? Replays, netcode and saves all depend on it.
